SELECT * FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`int_player_identity_map`

WITH redemptions AS (
    SELECT
        sk_campaign_id,
        sk_player_id,
        MIN(redemption_ts) AS first_redemption_ts,
        SUM(offer_amount) AS total_offer_amount
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`fct_campaign_redemption`
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

player_play AS (
    SELECT
        sk_player_id,
        rating_ts,
        theo_amount
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`fct_ratings`
),

performance_calc AS (
    SELECT
        r.sk_campaign_id,
        r.sk_player_id,
        TRUE AS is_redeemed,
        r.total_offer_amount,
        -- Post-campaign play: Theo generated within 3 days AFTER redemption
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN
                p.rating_ts BETWEEN r.first_redemption_ts
                AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(r.first_redemption_ts, INTERVAL 3 DAY)
                THEN p.theo_amount
            ELSE 0
        END) AS post_campaign_theo,

        -- Baseline play: Theo generated in the 3 days PRIOR to redemption
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN
                p.rating_ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(
                    r.first_redemption_ts, INTERVAL 3 DAY
                )
                AND r.first_redemption_ts
                THEN p.theo_amount
            ELSE 0
        END) AS baseline_theo
    FROM redemptions r
    LEFT JOIN player_play p ON r.sk_player_id = p.sk_player_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)

SELECT
    sk_campaign_id,
    sk_player_id,
    is_redeemed,
    total_offer_amount,
    post_campaign_theo,
    baseline_theo,
    -- Core Business Metrics defined in one place
    (post_campaign_theo - baseline_theo) AS incremental_theo,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(total_offer_amount, post_campaign_theo) AS reinvestment_rate
FROM performance_calc

WITH daily_play AS (
    SELECT
        sk_player_id,
        CAST(rating_ts AS DATE) AS date_day,
        SUM(coin_in) AS daily_coin_in,
        SUM(theo_amount) AS daily_theo
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`fct_ratings`
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

lagged_play AS (
    SELECT
        date_day,
        sk_player_id,
        daily_coin_in,
        daily_theo,
        -- Window function to find the previous date of play
        LAG(date_day)
            OVER (PARTITION BY sk_player_id ORDER BY date_day)
            AS previous_play_date
    FROM daily_play
)

SELECT
    p.date_day,
    p.sk_player_id,
    d.tier,
    p.daily_coin_in,
    p.daily_theo,
    -- Calculate days since last play for activity tracking
    DATE_DIFF(p.date_day, p.previous_play_date, DAY) AS days_since_last_play,
    -- Boolean flag for quick BI filtering on active players
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.date_day, DAY) <= 30 THEN TRUE ELSE
            FALSE
    END AS is_active_30d
FROM lagged_play p
JOIN `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`dim_players` d ON p.sk_player_id = d.sk_player_id
